# Benchmark Negative Transfer Audit

Positive delta is M5 gap minus M4 gap (regression). M4 and all six M5 results are frozen greedy evaluations over byte-identical benchmark coordinates. TSPLIB48/22 are derived from the author-exact frozen split; TSPLIB22 is not described as pristine because it has been repeatedly observed.
